entries.name: TEST_Ember Lance
entries.text:
TEST_Ember Lance
1st-level evocation
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 90 feet
Components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot)
Duration: Instantaneous

A lance of embers streaks toward a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 fire damage and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

entries.name: TEST_Whisper of Moss
entries.text:
TEST_Whisper of Moss
Transmutation cantrip
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Touch
Components: V, S
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

You touch a patch of moss or lichen, and it whispers the name of the last creature that walked over it. The whisper is audible only to you.
